list.snippet: What it is: A global peer-to-peer ride-hailing and delivery platform.
Pricing Model: Passengers propose a fair fare, and drivers can accept it or offer a counter-offer.
Indian Presence: Available in major cities including Bangalore, Mumbai, New Delhi, Hyderabad, Pune, and Kolkata.
City Rides: Daily point-to-point transportation within urban areas.
City to City: Long-distance intercity travel options.
Delivery & Freight: Courier services for sending packages and freight delivery.
Driver Selection: Choose drivers based on their ratings, reviews, and vehicle details before confirming.
Trip Sharing: Real-time location sharing with friends and family.
Emergency Support: In-app SOS button and safety toolkit.

There is no proper passenger category, so you can drive 5–8 km to collect a passenger only to find that 5–7 people are trying to fit into a 5-seater. about_this_app.snippet: inDrive is a great taxi service alternative and delivery app, which you can use to book city and intercity rides and order delivery or join as a driver or courier.You can use inDrive to book a convenient city ride, travel to other cities, or send and receive packages at a fair price. The main idea is the same for all services: A fair price is the one you agree on — not hope for. inDrive exists to prove that people can always come to an agreement. Silicon Valley’s new success story, inDrive, formerly inDriver, is a free rider & driver app available in more than 1065 cities in 48 countries. We are growing fast by putting the power back in the hands of people, be them passengers, drivers, or couriers.inDrive is available in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Lucknow, Kolkata, Chennai, Chandigarh, Pune, Ahmedabad, Surat, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Bhopal.As a customer, you can quickly find a ride or another service you need and agree on a fair fare with your driver or courier. As a driver, you can drive flexibly on your schedule and choose which rides you take. The same goes for our couriers.inDrive is not only a rider app or a driver app, it offers many more services based on the same model:CITYAffordable everyday rides with no surge pricing.INTERCITYA safe and convenient way to travel between cities.COURIERThis door-to-door on-demand delivery service is a fast and safe way to send and receive packages of up to 20 kilos.Why Choose inDriveQUICK AND EASYIt's simple and fast to request an affordable ride — just enter points ""A"" and ""B"", name your fare and choose your driver — or a courier if you use inDrive as a delivery app.OFFER YOUR FAREinDrive provides you with a tailored, surge-free experience. Here you, and not the algorithm, decide on the fare and choose the driver. We do not set the pricing according to time and mileage like other services.CHOOSE YOUR DRIVERinDrive lets you choose your driver from a list of the drivers who accepted your ride request. In our riding and driving app, you can pick them based on their price offer, car model, arrival time, rating, and the number of completed trips.STAY SAFESee the driver's name, car model, license plate number, and the number of completed trips before accepting the ride — something that is rarely to be found in any ordinary taxi service in India. During your trip, you can share your trip info with family or friends using the ""Share Your Ride"" button. We're continuously adding new safety features to make sure both riders and drivers can enjoy a 100% safe experience.ADD EXTRA OPTIONSYou can write your specific needs or any other details in the comments field like ""traveling with my pet,"" “I have luggage,"" etc. The driver will be able to see it in their app before they accept your request.JOIN AS A COURIER AND DRIVERIf you have a car, our driving app provides a great opportunity to make extra money. Unlike any other cab booking app, inDrive lets you see the rider's drop-off location and fare before you accept the ride request. If the rider's price doesn’t seem enough, this driver app allows you to offer your fare or skip the rides you don’t like with no penalties, which no cab driver can even dream of. The best thing is our low-to-no service rates, which means you can make more money driving with inDrive! A great alternative to your ordinary cab booking service, inDrive (inDriver) is a smart way to book rides and fast deliveries at a fair price in India.
